decisions.reason: The same source message already introduces the complete lead-free requirement for all boards; the QR-code modification adds no further change to this candidate.
Requiring a QR code on every board does not change the defined contents of the power-board production package.
The QR-code marking requirement does not alter component availability, fallback, or sourcing rules.
The source requires a board marking but does not change the sensor-board package's BOM, Gerber, drill-file, or pick-and-place deliverables.
The QR-code requirement does not change the candidate's component-replacement or manufacturing-package state.
Adding a QR code does not modify the task of reviewing component orientations in the manufacturing platform.
The source decision changes board markings, not the manufacturing-account access, cart setup, or upload-check procedure.
The QR-code marking requirement does not alter ESP32 pin access, breakout technology, module pin count, or assembly-header requirements.
The source decision does not affect sensor logic levels, level-shifter footprints, or future adapter-board handling.
Board identification markings do not change interboard connector types, signals, pin ordering, or matching-numbering requirements.
The QR-code requirement does not affect the main board's local decoupling requirement.
The source decision does not change panel controls, GPIO mappings, connector usage, button placement, or capacitance.
